_comment: Merge the `hooks` block into your .claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json) in one reviewed commit (H6). INTERACTIVE sessions only: do not add it to a driver child's
profile (a child is told about its own stops by the driver). Every hook runs the human's `notify_command` through .claude/scripts/notify.py and sends nothing itself.
The hook event names Notification, StopFailure and PermissionRequest and the fields of their input are unverified on the pinned CLI (probe); notify.py reads only
hook_event_name, notification_type and tool_name from the input, never its free text, and does nothing when no notify_command is configured.
